source_content: Notebook wrapper imports price_automl_optuna_v3.run_training; NSGA_TRIALS=180, TPE_TRIALS=120, num_anchors=3; optional warm_config/warm_trials
implementation: Project implementation of the documented V3 design, built on the preserved supplied V2 six-model core. Not a byte-identical port of the missing V3 module.
shared_changes: Two semantic types: numeric and unordered configuration. Training-only one-hot encoding for configuration attributes, then original training-only MinMax and original price-expert transformations. Numeric V2 remains equivalent to supplied source.
v3_changes: Fixed anchor split seeds; global independent seed escapes
Weight-only refinement with bounded per-model prediction caching
Data/protocol identity checks for history reuse
Union selection over both phases and compatible imported history
